findings.title: Near-duplicate self-join is quadratic and unauthenticated (remediated 2026-09-19)
findings.description: The pairwise self-join over every note path ran for tens of seconds on the live corpus for a single unauthenticated GET.
findings.root_cause: an O(n^2) mean-vector comparison executed per request with no corpus ceiling and no memo
findings.intended_behavior: a read endpoint should bound the work it can be asked to do

evidence.description: the AVAIL-1 comment records 52.8 s over 9,282 company docs (43 M pairs)
_NEAR_DUP_CACHE_MAX = 64 bounds the memo so min_sim cannot trade CPU for RAM

conditions.description: requires a corpus large enough for the quadratic term to matter

execution.attacker_perspective: an unauthenticated client issuing repeated GETs
instructions: repeat the request to defeat any cache
execution.observed_result: 52.8 s per uncached call over 9,282 docs before the fix; 1.65 s at 1,186 paths after the GEMM rewrite

remediation.strategy: memoize on the cache generation (LRU 64) + refuse above 10,000 distinct paths with 503

likelihood.reason: trivial to trigger, but the corpus must be large

impact.reason: one request parks a worker for tens of seconds

confidence.reason: the pre-fix timing is recorded in the code comment and the regression tests

findings.title: Unauthenticated mutating POST rebuilds the graph cache
findings.description: POST /api/graph/refresh rebuilds the DuckDB cache and resets the shared connection with no authentication or CSRF check.
findings.root_cause: the route is registered with no auth decorator and no in-handler credential check
findings.intended_behavior: a mutating admin endpoint should require an operator credential

trace.description: _reset_graph_connection() then rebuild() run for any caller

evidence.description: the decorator list is empty: no login_required, no token check

conditions.description: deploy-gated: the app is not publicly exposed; Phase 4 endpoints are dormant

execution.attacker_perspective: any host that can reach the Flask listener
instructions: send the POST with no headers or cookies
execution.observed_result: HTTP 200 and a rebuild log line, with no credential presented

remediation.strategy: require an operator token (or bind the route to localhost-only) before Phase 4 enables it

likelihood.reason: no credential is checked on any path

impact.reason: a rebuild is idempotent and the endpoint is deploy-gated

confidence.reason: the decorator and the handler body were both read
